Wide shot of a sleeping city at night. Every window is dark except one, at the top of an old apartment building.

Somewhere, someone is always awake.

Inside the lit window: NINA (12) sits at a desk covered in drawings, a flashlight in her mouth, sketching furiously.

Nina

Almost... almost there...

Close-up of the drawing: a paper fox with folded ears. One of its eyes seems to blink.

Nina drops the flashlight. The fox is climbing out of the page.

Fox

Finally. Do you know how long I have been waiting in that sketchbook?


Nina and the fox face each other across the desk, both equally surprised.

Nina

You... talk?

Fox

I talk, I run, and I am terribly hungry. Is there any paper left?

That was the night Nina stopped sleeping.
